project_type: Full-stack web app: FastAPI backend + Next.js 15 frontend (monorepo)
build_system: uv for Python, pnpm for Node.js, Makefile for convenience commands
test_framework: pytest with pytest-asyncio (backend), pnpm build for frontend type-checking
build_command: cd apps/api && uv run ruff check . && cd ../../apps/web && pnpm build
test_command: cd apps/api && uv run pytest tests/ -v
verification_instructions: 1. Run `uv run pytest tests/ -v` in apps/api. 2. Run `pnpm build` in apps/web. 3. Run `uv run ruff check .` in apps/api.
setup_instructions: cd apps/api && uv sync; cd apps/web && pnpm install
environment_constraints: Docker NOT available - cannot run containers or test Dockerfiles. No Redis available. Tests must work without external services (DB, Redis, Qdrant, S3 all mocked). OPEN_INTERNET network so pnpm/uv can install packages.
contribution_requirements: Conventional commits. Run ruff check before committing. All 127+ tests must pass. pnpm build must succeed.

key_patterns.backend_routing: Routers in apps/api/app/router/*.py, registered in main.py. Dependencies via apps/api/app/deps.py.
key_patterns.backend_testing: Tests in apps/api/tests/test_*.py using mock_user, mock_db, and httpx AsyncClient fixtures from conftest.py.
key_patterns.frontend_pages: App router: apps/web/src/app/(app)/ for authenticated pages, (auth)/ for auth pages. Landing page at apps/web/src/app/page.tsx.
key_patterns.frontend_components: Components in apps/web/src/components/{chat,knowledge,tables,charts,files,ui}/. Single button in ui/.
key_patterns.styling: Tailwind CSS v4 with CSS variables for theming (light/dark). Class-based dark mode (.dark class). Design tokens in globals.css.
key_patterns.api_client: Frontend uses apps/web/src/lib/api.ts (apiFetch, apiJson) with token-based auth from localStorage.
key_patterns.auth_pattern: JWT auth, token stored in localStorage, AuthProvider context in auth-context.tsx.
key_patterns.settings: Backend settings in apps/api/app/settings.py using pydantic-settings.

directory_structure: apps/api/ = FastAPI backend (app/, tests/, alembic/); apps/web/ = Next.js frontend (src/app/, src/components/, src/hooks/, src/lib/, src/styles/); infra/docker/ = Docker compose files; docs/ = project documentation; packages/ = shared types (planned)
